title: Autumn Leaves & Forest Coloring Book: Cozy Fall Scenes with Bold and Easy Designs for Adults
subtitle: 50 Relaxing Cottagecore Illustrations of Maple Leaves, Woodland Paths, Cozy Cabins, and Harvest Scenes for Stress Relief
description:
Step into the golden warmth of autumn and color your way to calm!


This charming coloring book features 50 cozy autumn forest scenes drawn in a cute cottagecore style with bold, easy-to-color outlines. Wander through forest paths carpeted with fallen leaves, discover mushrooms under ancient oaks, and relax beside crackling cabin fireplaces.

What's Inside:
• 50 unique autumn and forest illustrations
• Maple leaves, oak trees, pinecones, acorns, pumpkins, and mushrooms
• Cozy cabins, forest streams, deer, squirrels, and harvest scenes
• Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through
• Bold, easy-to-color outlines perfect for colored pencils, markers, and gel pens

Perfect For:
• Relaxation and stress relief
• Fall and autumn lovers
• Nature and woodland enthusiasts
• Anyone who enjoys cozy cottagecore art

Grab your warm-toned pencils and lose yourself in the beauty of autumn!

cover_prompt: Full-color vibrant illustration of a cozy autumn forest scene. SQUARE format (1:1 aspect ratio). A winding forest path covered with fallen maple leaves in brilliant shades of orange, gold, red, and amber. Tall oak and maple trees with colorful canopies arch over the path. In the midground, a charming stone cottage with warm light glowing from its windows and smoke curling from the chimney. A friendly deer stands near the path beside scattered pumpkins and mushrooms. Pinecones and acorns litter the ground among ferns. Warm golden afternoon sunlight filters through the canopy creating dappled light. Cottagecore aesthetic with rich warm autumn colors. Professional book cover art. DO NOT include any text in the image.
